entities.summary: Kabadüz is a municipality and district of Ordu Province, Turkey. Its area is 343 km2, and its population is 7,055 (2022). The town lies at an elevation of 580 m (1,903 ft). Kabadüz is a district of green hillsides, 21 km inland from the city of Ordu.
